$meta.source: design/source/*.dc.html, design/source/tilo-*.js, design/source/worlds/k1-generator.js (Claude Design exports for Tilo)
$meta.method: Grepped inline CSS hex values and JS colour constants across all 12 .dc.html canvases and the 3 tilo-*.js kits; cross-referenced the explicit swatch labels in the 'Token card' section (data-screen-label="2-6 Token card" in Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html), which is the only file that names its colours against role-like labels (Iris/hero, Ink, Ground/line, Success, Needs you, Blocked, Info, Neutral, district tints). Values not directly labelled were inferred from where they are used (e.g. button fills, status pins in tilo-world.js) and are marked status: inferred. PRD roles with no matching value anywhere in the exports are set to null with status: missing — none were invented.
$meta.activeTheme: 'balanced2' in tilo-kit.js TH — the theme object actually selected by Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html's component script (const THEME = 'balanced2'). Other theme variants ('crisp', 'lively', 'balanced') exist in the same file as earlier round options and are not used by any shipped screen.

primary.source: Token card, swatch 'Iris · hero' (Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html, 2-6); also the fill of every primary button across Home/Home v2/World Player etc.

primary-lip.source: Same 'Iris · hero' swatch, bottom-shadow value; matches the box-shadow:'0 4px 0 0 #3F2AAE' used under every primary button.

0.source: Token card, swatch 'Ground · line' first value; page background on Home, Home v2, Worlds, Ledger, Skills, Team.

1.source: Card, header and panel fills throughout (e.g. header background in Tilo Home.dc.html; the Token card's own background).

2.source: inferred — outer <body> background specifically in the world-canvas pages (Parts Watch, Tilo Cities, Tilo Metropolis, Tilo World Kit, Tilo World Player). Reads as a third, slightly darker neutral layer behind the app surfaces, but it is not explicitly named as a role anywhere.

district.note: PRD 18.2 wants 6 generic solver-assigned slots (district.1-6). The exports never expose numbered slots — tilo-kit.js (TH.balanced2.dist) and worlds/k1-generator.js (DIST) instead define a pool of named tints that a solver would presumably cycle through. Listing the pool as found; treat 'district.1-6' as missing in the literal sense.

hall.source: Token card district-tint row, 'Town Hall'; also tilo-kit.js TH.balanced2.dist.hall

accounts.source: worlds/k1-generator.js DIST.accounts (not shown in the Token card)

mail.source: worlds/k1-generator.js DIST.mail (Mail Room / Email Autopilot district)

done.source: Token card, swatch 'Success'; = tilo-world.js K0.ok / ST.ok, used on building complete/check pins

needs.source: Token card, swatch 'Needs you' (labelled 'ink text', i.e. dark text on this fill, not white); = K0.amber

fyi.source: Token card, swatch 'Info' (closest match to the PRD's 'fyi'); = K0.blue, used for the fyi pin/dot in tilo-world.js

nudge.source: inferred — Tilo World Player.dc.html reuses brand purple for nudge toasts ('dot:#5A3FE0') and for meeting.called/meeting.decision/app.deployed marks in its timeline colour map (MC). No dedicated 'nudge' swatch exists anywhere in the exports.

gate.source: No dedicated colour found. gate() in both tilo-kit.js and tilo-world.js renders the gate glyph in signal.done green when open and in ink.2 grey when closed, plus a lock icon — there is no single hue standing for 'gate' the way there is for done/needs/blocked/fyi.

1.source: Token card, swatch 'Ink' primary value; the body/heading text colour set on almost every screen root.

2.source: Token card, swatch 'Ink' secondary value; the most-used text colour in the exports (295 occurrences) for meta/secondary text.

3.source: Only two ink levels are defined anywhere (the Token card's 'Ink' swatch gives exactly two hexes). #66717A ('Neutral' status swatch) is the nearest lighter neutral but it is only ever used as a fill, never as text colour, so it was not assumed to be ink.3.

fog.source: worlds/k1-generator.js K0.cloudD (shadow) / K0.cloud (highlight), drawn by the clouds() function in tilo-world.js over locked/no-access islands — this is the PRD's 'cloud cover' glyph (9.1).

policy.source: No colour for policy-authorised actions (HR-7 / the 18.2 'policy' role) exists anywhere in the exports. The only building/kit reference to 'policy' is a building named 'Policy Archive' in Tilo Cities.dc.html, which is unrelated to the design-token role.

65 occurrences — darker lip/shadow under #F7F6F2 and #E3E0D8 surfaces (e.g. secondary-button box-shadow)
34 occurrences — light tint of brand.primary, used for selected chips, 'Recommended' pill background, radius swatches
22 occurrences — light tint of signal.done, used behind 'Fixed' review findings and success matrix cells
18 occurrences — light tint of signal.needs, used behind at-risk/needs-you rows in Parts Watch and Ledger
11 occurrences — lip/shadow for the 'Neutral' (#66717A) status swatch
Token card swatch 'Tide · accent' (fill/lip) — a second brand accent colour defined but not clearly used as a role anywhere else in the exports
district.research lip, and also the 'connection.*' colour in Tilo World Player's timeline marker map (MC)
dark amber text tone used when a district/card 'needs you' (paired with the #FFF3D6 / #F0A500 needs fills)
2 occurrences, a second red slightly different from signal.blocked (#D23B30) — unclear if intentional variant or inconsistency

display.source: Google Fonts link on every .dc.html; used for the 'tilo' wordmark and all large headings (Token card 'Type' section: 'Display — Nunito 900 · 56/32/24/20').

ui.source: Google Fonts link on every .dc.html; set as the root font-family on every screen (e.g. Tilo Home.dc.html body div).

mono.source: Google Fonts link on every .dc.html (weight 500 everywhere, 700 added only in Tilo World Player.dc.html); used for hex values, timestamps and Trace-lens rows.

unusedButReferenced.note: Loaded in Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html's Google Fonts link; only used by tilo-kit.js's unused 'crisp' theme variant (TH.crisp.body). Does not appear in any shipped screen text.
Same file/link as Figtree; not referenced by the active 'balanced2' theme or any .dc.html text. Purpose unclear — possibly a leftover from an earlier round.

font.prdScaleComparison: PRD 18.2 specifies a clean 12/14/16/20/24/32/40 scale. All seven of those values do appear, but the exports also use many half-step and one-off sizes (12.5, 13.5, 14.5, 15, 15.5, 17, 19, 22, 26, 28, 30, 44, 52, 56) that are not part of the documented scale — the canvases were tuned freely rather than snapped to tokens.

buttons_px.source: Token card 'Radii' section, '16 · buttons'; matches every primary/secondary button's border-radius:16px.

cards_px.source: Token card 'Radii' section, '24 · cards'; matches e.g. the 'Deep dive' approach card's border-radius:24px.

pill_px.source: Nav pills, status chips, tag badges throughout.

radius.prdComparison: PRD 18.2 specifies 12px controls / 20px cards and sheets. The exports use 16px for controls/buttons (not 12) and 24px for cards (not 20); a literal 20px radius appears only 5 times across all files versus 127 uses of 16px and 48 of 24px — the shipped radius scale has drifted from the PRD spec.

shadow_lip.pattern: box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 <lip-colour> — a flat 'pressed key' lip under buttons and cards, collapsing to 0 on press (transform: translateY(4px)). Matches PRD 18.2's '4 px darker bottom lip' exactly.
shadow_lip.source: Consistent across all primary/secondary buttons (Tilo Home.dc.html, component strip in Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html) and the Token card's own palette swatches (which use a taller 0 5px 0 0 lip for its larger 64px demo tiles).

press_ms.source: Tilo 2 Balanced Refined.dc.html, component-strip button anatomy note: 'label drops 4px and the lip collapses in 100ms'.

buildPop_ms.source: Tilo World Kit.dc.html build-sequence caption: 'Buildings pop into their real state with a 280ms overshoot, back to front, 60ms apart.'

groundRise_ms.source: Tilo World Kit.dc.html build-sequence caption: 'The island slab and ring road appear. Soft 300ms rise.'

motion.prdComparison: PRD 18.2 specifies 120ms press / 200ms sheets / 320ms camera. Every timed value found in the exports runs slower than spec: press is 100ms (close), but camera easing is 650ms — roughly double the PRD's 320ms — and no sheet-open duration (200ms) was found documented anywhere.

spacing.note: gap/padding values were tallied across all 12 .dc.html files. Common values cluster at 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 24, 28, 40, 48px with no single 4pt or 8pt grid enforced (e.g. 6px and 14px are each used dozens of times alongside 8px and 16px). Treat as organic/hand-tuned rather than tokenised.
